fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/bear-creek-campground-and-picnic-area ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'There is a $15.00 per night fee for overnight camping'; page last updated August 31, 2026), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/bear-creek-campground-and-picnic-area ('the campground includes 12 designated campsites', 'The recommended maximum trailer length is 28 feet'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump in spring and summer. No garbage service (pack out all trash); bear-resistant food storage boxes. Stock allowed (not on the south side of the creek).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/bear-creek-campground-and-picnic-area ('The campground has a vault toilet, and drinking water is available in spring and summer. No garbage service is provided', 'Bear-resistant food storage boxes are available', 'drinking water is available from a hand pump', 'Stock are not permitted on the south side of the creek'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use: Open annually from early May through late November, weather dependent'; its Operational Hours say early June through late November.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/bear-creek-campground-and-picnic-area ('Reservations: First come-first served.', 'The stay limit is 16 days'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD) campground at 6,350 ft along Bear Creek, ~10 mi E of Cameron in the Madison Valley (S of Ennis); trailhead for the Bear Creek Loop Trail into the Lee Metcalf Wilderness, shared by family campers and stock parties. No cell coverage. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Madison RD), first-come. Confirmed $15 (FS page updated 2026-08-31), 12 sites, vault toilet, hand-pump drinking water, FCFS, 16-day limit. Added 28-ft recommended max trailer, season (early May or early June through late November; the page gives both). No current alert names it. Note trimmed of restated values and the aggregator's 22-ft figure.
